# FortiGate: clear x1 (vlan70, vlan200-TEST, 192.168.201.1) and x2 (fortilink) for the LAG (step 1a)
# Generated by plans/gen-fortigate-cli.py from the 13/14 Oct 2026 captures. Do not edit; re-run.
# Lines starting with # are comments for the reader; FortiOS ignores them when pasted.

# STEP 1a: free x1 and x2 so they can join the new aggregate. PLANNED OUTAGE for PlanetB (vlan70)
# and island management (192.168.201.0/24) from here until 40-fgt-build is applied. Mat at the console.
# Order matters: policies, then addresses, then DHCP servers, then VLAN interfaces, then the parent.
# "entry is used" from FortiOS means something above was missed; stop and look, nothing is damaged.

config firewall policy
    delete 32   # "vlan70"
    delete 33   # "vlan200-TEST"
    delete 34   # "Interface LAN x1"
end

config firewall address
    delete "vlan70 address"
    delete "vlan200-TEST address"
    delete "x1 address"
end

config system dhcp server
    delete 31   # vlan70
    delete 32   # vlan200-TEST
    delete 33   # x1
    delete 3   # fortilink
end
config system dhcp6 server
    delete 1   # fortilink
end

config system interface
    delete "vlan70"
    delete "vlan200-TEST"
    edit "x1"
        set ip 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
        unset allowaccess
        set alias ''
        set role undefined
    next
    edit "fortilink"
        set fortilink disable
        unset member
    next
    delete "fortilink"   # may say "entry is used"; harmless, x2 is already free after unset member
    edit "port16"   # down, but holds 192.168.1.99/24: FortiOS refuses the aggregate's 192.168.1.1/24 while this exists
        set ip 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
        unset allowaccess
    next
end

# Check before building: diagnose netlink aggregate list   (x1 and x2 in no aggregate)
#                        get system interface physical   (x1 no IP, x2 no IP)
